name: Tuna Niçoise Salad with Boiled Egg, Potatoes, Tomatoes, Green Beans & Olives (Two Ways)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use this recipe as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
227 g new potatoes
113 g green beans
½ lemon
½ small pkg chives
1 English cucumber
½ pint grape tomatoes
½ (142 g) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)
1 (170 g) pkg blackberries

instructions.primary_message: Halve new potatoes. Place in a medium saucepan, along with salt, and cover with hot water (from the tap). Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer until fork-tender, 10-12 minutes. Drain, rinse under cold water to cool, and set aside.
Meanwhile, fill another medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap). Cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
While the water comes to a boil, trim green beans.

Once the water in the pan is boiling, add green beans and cook until tender-crisp, 2-3 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer green beans to the colander and run under cold water to cool. Drain, transfer to a plate, and set aside. (Reserve pan of boiling water for the next step.)
Add eggs to the pan of boiling water, then reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes. Drain hot water and add ice or run under cold water to cool; set aside.
Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Arrange bread on a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until golden brown and toasted, about 2 minutes. Remove from oven.
Drain tuna and flake with a fork. Place 1 can of tuna in a medium bowl along with mayo, Dijon, and spices. Stir to combine the tuna salad. (Reserve remaining tuna for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 (120 g) can chunk light tuna in water
2 tbsp mayonnaise
1 tsp Dijon mustard
¼ tsp onion powder
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Top toasted bread with the tuna salad and cheese, then return to the baking sheet. Return baking sheet to the oven and continue to broil until cheese is melted and bubbly, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from oven and cut tuna melts in half crosswise. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: ⅓ cup shredded cheese, Italian blend

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, juice lemon into a medium bowl.
Chop chives into small pieces. Add to the bowl with the lemon juice, along with oil, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp Dijon mustard
1 tsp honey
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and slice cucumber crosswise into thin rounds. Set a ½-cup of sliced cucumber aside for the kid plates, then add remaining cucumber to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl, along with the mixed greens, olives, and reserved tuna, then toss to combine the salad.
Peel and quarter eggs, then season with salt.

FOR THE KID PLATES: Divide tuna melts, reserved cucumbers, and blackberries between plates. 

FOR THE ADULT PLATES: Divide salad between plates or bowls, then top with potatoes, green beans, and eggs. Enjoy!
